title: What does a website cost in Switzerland in 2026? An honest price comparison
author: Renee Editorial
summary: The price of a website depends mainly on the number of pages, languages, design and features. Quotes can only be compared if the scope is identical. Our websites start {{price.website}} {{vat}}

list: Number of pages and page types
Number of languages and who writes the copy
Features such as booking, shop or customer login

p: A website is not finished at launch. Factor in domain, hosting, security updates and content maintenance. Static websites have an advantage here: they need no database and hardly any maintenance.
We deliberately do not publish market averages here, because reliable, comparable figures are lacking and scope varies widely. Instead, get three quotes based on the same briefing and check:
list: How many correction rounds are included?
Who owns the code, design and access?
What does it cost to run per year?
